# MeshHub Copilot Skills

This catalog lists project-level Copilot skills installed in [skills](.).
Use these skills via slash commands in chat (for example: `/security-review`).

| Skill Folder | Primary Use | Bundled Assets |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [codeql](codeql) | Configure and troubleshoot CodeQL scanning workflows | Yes |
| [create-implementation-plan](create-implementation-plan) | Create structured implementation plans for features/refactors | No |
| [create-specification](create-specification) | Create AI-optimized technical specifications | No |
| [dependabot](dependabot) | Configure Dependabot update strategy and policy | Yes |
| [documentation-writer](documentation-writer) | Produce Diataxis-style technical documentation | No |
| [gh-cli](gh-cli) | Use GitHub CLI for repo/issue/PR/actions workflows | No |
| [multi-stage-dockerfile](multi-stage-dockerfile) | Create optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles | No |
| [polyglot-test-agent](polyglot-test-agent) | Generate comprehensive unit tests across languages | Yes |
| [premium-frontend-ui](premium-frontend-ui) | Craft high-quality frontend UI/UX and interaction polish | No |
| [security-review](security-review) | Perform security-focused codebase audits | Yes |
| [update-implementation-plan](update-implementation-plan) | Update existing implementation plans with new requirements | No |
| [webapp-testing](webapp-testing) | Test local web apps with Playwright workflows | Yes |

## Quick Start

1. Open Copilot Chat in agent mode.
2. Invoke a skill directly, for example:
   - `/security-review review backend auth and upload modules`
   - `/webapp-testing verify login and model viewer flows`
   - `/create-specification generate spec for org dashboard improvements`
3. Confirm the skill output and continue with implementation.
